editorial:
Imagine a classic game of cat and mouse where the stakes are high and the laughs are loud. You get a tiny mouse who is just trying to survive, a hungry cat who will not quit, and a grumpy bulldog who just wants to sleep. It is a wild ride from the start, with a vibe that feels like a vintage comic strip come to life. The way the characters interact creates a funny chain reaction of chaos that keeps you smiling throughout the whole short. 

What really makes this one work is the clever humor and the fast pacing. You will love the part where the cat tries to blend in with the chickens, which is honestly a highlight of the whole thing. While it is an older cartoon, the timing is still perfect today. If you are in the mood for some old-school slapstick, you should definitely track this down. You can try renting it on Apple TV or adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection for the best picture quality. It is a great pick for a quick laugh with the family.
endingExplained: The story takes a dark turn when the bulldog gets tired of the mouse's games. After the mouse points to an empty dump, the dog attacks him. In a last-ditch effort to fight back, the mouse paints an apple black and lights a fuse to make a bomb. However, the plan fails miserably. The apple explodes right in the mouse's face, sending him straight to mouse heaven in a classic cartoon twist.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic Looney Tunes style humor.
